title: Vietnamy exercise profiles
description: Named recipes that control which question types a lesson generates. A lesson references one by id (curriculum lesson.exerciseProfileId); if it doesn't, levelDefaults maps its CEFR band to a profile, falling back to defaultProfileId.

levelDefaults.description: CEFR band (A1, A2, B1, ...) → profile id, used when a lesson has no explicit profile.

options.description: Knobs passed to the exercise generator. Absent/false means the default behavior.
